Review_Text: I started my first SIP of 1000 rupees on Groww in January. After 3 months my portfolio value became 2850 rupees (negative returns). Nobody explained market volatility and I got scared so I cancelled my SIP.
My bank mandate auto-debit failed on 5th March, and my bank charged 295 rupees ECS bounce penalty. Groww did not send any notification beforehand. Very frustrating experience for beginners.

Nice and smooth UI for buying gold and stocks.
I wanted to pause my SIP for 2 months because of medical expenses in my family. But there is no simple pause button, only cancel or skip 1 installment. So I had to delete the entire SIP.
Started investing via SIP because YouTube videos said it is risk-free. Now index went down 4% and I am in red. The app does not provide any reassurance or guidance during market corrections.
Customer support ticket #89421 took 6 days to respond when my installment amount of 2500 was deducted twice from HDFC bank account. Left in the dark without any acknowledgment.
Good app for investing, continuing my Nifty 50 index fund SIP for 8 months now without issues. Long term compounding is great.
Too many confusing metrics. XIRR vs CAGR vs Absolute Return makes no sense to a first time investor. I stopped contributing until I understand how returns are actually calculated.

Switched jobs and salary account changed from ICICI to Axis. Updating SIP bank mandate was so complicated and required physical courier or netbanking debit card which failed 4 times. Ended up pausing all SIPs.
